conventions.exposure: 300 s per observed quote pair, bucket of the pair's left endpoint TTR
conventions.detection: |eta_tilde_k| > 4 sigma_hat_k; sigma_hat_k^2 = (pi/2) mean of adjacent products |eta_i||eta_{i-1}| (consecutive pairs only) with |i-k| <= 12 observed pairs, excluding products involving k-1,k,k+1 (i in {k-1..k+2}); >=12 products else contract level
conventions.effective_innovations: eta_tilde = eta*sqrt(n/(n-d)) so sum eta_tilde^2/(n*300) = legacy sigma^2
conventions.sign: +1 YES taker, -1 NO taker; S_u = 2*1{V_u < u} - 1
conventions.release_time: broad_based: metadata occurrence_datetime (else template close, flagged); sports: template close (provisional)
conventions.noise_donors: templates without own quote support use the legacy MarketDynamics donor draw; sigma_c is the donor's
conventions.u_rates: u[tpl,b,k] = clip((n_yes + 20 u_class[b])/(n + 20), .02, .98); b = class quintile size bin (side='right' of interior edges); k = legacy lifetime phase
conventions.p0_emp: last training trade strictly before t_c - 3600 s, else first at/after; simulation start clipped to [.01,.99]

roster_note: Candidate roster before matching; R* (Section 8) additionally drops templates unmatched for any M arm.
limitations: Jumps are reduced-form proxies: large 300-s quote-midpoint residuals, not identified news events.
Quote support covers the trailing window (usually three days); intensities use that exposure only.
Sports release time is the provisional template close (official game-end timestamps deferred).
eta matches the train-median Kyle lambda in a flow-only post-trade replay; it does not identify informed traders.
u rates treat observed YES-taker frequencies as uninformed rates (alpha small).
Bootstrap ranges resample training contracts; they are sampling scenarios, not causal bounds.
